files.source:
"""Hold one OS-account-owned experimental device lock across exec."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

os.umask(0o077)
path = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
fd = os.open(path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
info = os.fstat(fd)
assert info.st_uid == os.getuid() and info.st_mode & 0o077 == 0
try:
    fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
except BlockingIOError:
    print('EXPERIMENT_DEVICE_BUSY', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(11)
record = {'version': 1, 'pid': os.getpid(), 'resource': str(path)}
os.ftruncate(fd, 0)
os.write(fd, json.dumps(record).encode())
os.fsync(fd)
held = fcntl.fcntl(fd, fcntl.F_DUPFD, 200)
os.close(fd)
os.set_inheritable(held, True)
os.environ['JEV_EXPERIMENT_LOCK_FD'] = str(held)
os.execv(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[2:])

"""Stop only attested automation in the two private devices; leave devices on."""
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import pwd
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time

prep_path, platform, snapshot_path = sys.argv[1:]
prep = json.loads(Path(prep_path).read_text())
snapshot = json.loads(Path(snapshot_path).read_text())
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
assert platform in ['ios', 'android'] and snapshot['platform'] == platform
assert prep['ios']['udid'] == '15013501-2535-42EB-A67F-45B015DF18F4', 'Refuse foreign device'
assert Path(prep['ios']['set']).resolve() == root / 'runtime/devices/simulators', 'Refuse foreign simulator set'
assert prep['android']['name'] == 'jev_appium_phase1_20261018' and prep['android']['serial'] == 'emulator-5570', 'Refuse foreign emulator'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('owned_group', Path(__file__).with_name('stop-group.py'))
group = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(group)
receipt = {'version': 1, 'platform': platform, 'commands': [], 'observations': [], 'deviceShutdownIssued': False, 'leaseReleased': False}
def run(args):
    result = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20, env={**os.environ, 'HOME': pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_dir})
    receipt['commands'].append({'args': args, 'exitCode': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr})
    return result

def ports_closed(ports):
    samples = []
    for port in ports:
        for family, address in [(socket.AF_INET, '127.0.0.1'), (socket.AF_INET6, '::1')]:
            with socket.socket(family, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as connection:
                connection.settimeout(0.5)
                samples.append({'port': port, 'address': address, 'closed': connection.connect_ex((address, port)) != 0})
    return samples

if platform == 'ios':
    base = ['xcrun', 'simctl', '--set', prep['ios']['set']]
    device = prep['ios']['udid']
    assert snapshot['device']['udid'] == device
    assert all(item['matchesSelected'] for item in snapshot['wda']['files'])
    assert [item['path'] for item in snapshot['wda']['files']] == [item['path'] for item in prep['wda']['files']]
    owned = [item for item in snapshot['services'] if item['automation']]
    assert owned and all(item['incarnation'] for item in owned)
    before = run(base + ['spawn', device, 'launchctl', 'list'])
    assert before.returncode == 0
    current = {int(fields[0]): fields[2] for line in before.stdout.splitlines() if len(fields := line.split(None, 2)) == 3 and fields[0].isdigit()}
    for item in owned:
        now = group.process_incarnation(item['pid'])
        if now == item['incarnation']:
            assert current.get(item['pid']) == item['label'], 'Automation identity changed'
    live = [item for item in owned if group.process_incarnation(item['pid']) == item['incarnation']]
    if live:
        result = run(base + ['terminate', device, 'com.facebook.WebDriverAgentRunner.xctrunner'])
        assert result.returncode == 0
    for attempt in range(8):
        listing = run(base + ['spawn', device, 'launchctl', 'list'])
        assert listing.returncode == 0
        running = [line for line in listing.stdout.splitlines() if 'com.facebook.WebDriverAgentRunner' in line and line.split()[0].isdigit()]
        endpoints = ports_closed([18100, 18101])
        receipt['observations'].append({'sample': attempt, 'automationServices': running, 'ports': endpoints})
        assert not running and all(item['closed'] for item in endpoints), 'AUTOMATION_FENCE_UNPROVEN'
        if attempt < 7: time.sleep(1)
    receipt['deviceRemainsRunning'] = True
else:
    base = ['adb', '-s', prep['android']['serial']]
    name = run(base + ['emu', 'avd', 'name'])
    assert name.returncode == 0 and name.stdout.splitlines()[0] == prep['android']['name']
    packages = ['io.appium.uiautomator2.server', 'io.appium.uiautomator2.server.test', 'io.appium.settings']
    assert {item['package'] for item in snapshot['packages']} == set(packages)
    for package in packages:
        stopped = run(base + ['shell', 'am', 'force-stop', package]); assert stopped.returncode == 0
        disabled = run(base + ['shell', 'pm', 'disable-user', '--user', '0', package])
        assert disabled.returncode == 0 and 'disabled-user' in disabled.stdout
    forwards = run(['adb', 'forward', '--list']); assert forwards.returncode == 0
    for local, remote in [('tcp:18200', 'tcp:6790'), ('tcp:18201', 'tcp:7810')]:
        rows = [line.split() for line in forwards.stdout.splitlines() if len(line.split()) == 3 and line.split()[1] == local]
        assert all(row == [prep['android']['serial'], local, remote] for row in rows), 'Foreign forward refused'
        if rows:
            result = run(base + ['forward', '--remove', local]); assert result.returncode == 0
    for attempt in range(8):
        result = run(base + ['shell', 'ps', '-A', '-o', 'PID,NAME']); assert result.returncode == 0
        remaining = [line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if len(fields := line.split()) == 2 and any(fields[1] == package or fields[1].startswith(package + ':') for package in packages)]
        endpoints = ports_closed([18200, 18201])
        receipt['observations'].append({'sample': attempt, 'automationProcesses': remaining, 'ports': endpoints})
        assert not remaining and all(item['closed'] for item in endpoints), 'AUTOMATION_FENCE_UNPROVEN'
        if attempt < 7: time.sleep(1)
    input_state = run(base + ['shell', 'dumpsys', 'input']); assert input_state.returncode == 0
    receipt['inputTouchSections'] = [line for line in input_state.stdout.splitlines() if 'TouchStatesByDisplay' in line or 'PointerIds' in line]
    assert any('TouchStatesByDisplay: <no displays touched>' in line for line in receipt['inputTouchSections']), 'INPUT_STATE_UNSETTLED'
    boot = run(base + ['shell', 'getprop', 'sys.boot_completed']); assert boot.returncode == 0 and boot.stdout.strip() == '1'
    receipt['deviceRemainsRunning'] = True
receipt['ownedAutomationInert'] = True
print(json.dumps(receipt))

"""Persist an owned child's precise identity BEFORE the intended executable."""
import hashlib
import base64
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sqlite3
import sys

os.umask(0o077)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('owned_group', Path(__file__).with_name('stop-group.py'))
group = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(group)
directory = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
owner = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text())
assert os.getppid() == owner['pid'], 'UNRECORDED_PARENT_REFUSED'
command, argv0, *args = sys.argv[3:]
executable = shutil.which(command)
if executable is None:
    raise RuntimeError('NATIVE_EXECUTABLE_UNAVAILABLE')
executable = str(Path(executable).resolve())
db = sqlite3.connect('file:' + str(directory / 'stop-journal.sqlite') + '?mode=ro', uri=True, timeout=5)
try:
    state = json.loads(db.execute('SELECT state FROM run WHERE id=1').fetchone()[0])
finally:
    db.close()
identity = group.process_incarnation(os.getpid())
record = {'version': 1, 'runId': state['runId'], 'pid': os.getpid(), 'ppid': os.getppid(), 'pgid': os.getpgrp(), 'sid': os.getsid(0),
          'incarnation': identity, 'ownerPid': owner['pid'], 'ownerIncarnation': owner['incarnation'],
          'executable': executable, 'executableSha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(executable).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'argumentsSha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([argv0, *args], separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest(),
          'commandId': state['commands'][-1]['id'] if state['commands'] else None,
          'disposition': 'refused-before-exec' if state['closed'] else 'authorized-exec'}
assert os.environ.get('JEV_PHASE1_RUN_MARKER') == owner['runMarker'], 'MISSING_RUN_MARKER'
chain = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(os.environ['JEV_PHASE1_ANCESTRY']))
assert chain[0] == owner['launchChain'][0], 'UNRECORDED_ANCESTRY'
chain.append({'pid': record['pid'], 'incarnation': identity})
record['runMarker'] = owner['runMarker']
record['launchChain'] = chain
os.environ['JEV_PHASE1_ANCESTRY'] = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(chain, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).decode()
record_path = directory / 'components' / (str(os.getpid()) + '-' + hashlib.sha256(identity.encode()).hexdigest() + '.json')
with record_path.open('x') as file:
    json.dump(record, file)
    file.flush()
    os.fsync(file.fileno())
fd = os.open(record_path.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
try:
    os.fsync(fd)
finally:
    os.close(fd)
if state['closed'] or group.process_incarnation(owner['pid']) != owner['incarnation']:
    raise RuntimeError('DISPATCH_CLOSED')
os.execvpe(executable, [argv0, *args], os.environ)

"""Read-only component/artifact observations in the fixed private device context."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import pwd
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

prep_path, platform = sys.argv[1:]
prep = json.loads(Path(prep_path).read_text())
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
assert platform in ['ios', 'android']
assert prep['ios']['udid'] == '15013501-2535-42EB-A67F-45B015DF18F4', 'Refuse foreign device'
assert Path(prep['ios']['set']).resolve() == root / 'runtime/devices/simulators', 'Refuse foreign simulator set'
assert prep['android']['name'] == 'jev_appium_phase1_20261018' and prep['android']['serial'] == 'emulator-5570', 'Refuse foreign emulator'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('owned_group', Path(__file__).with_name('stop-group.py'))
group = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(group)
commands = []
def run(args, binary=False):
    result = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, timeout=20, env={**os.environ, 'HOME': pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_dir})
    commands.append({'args': args, 'exitCode': result.returncode})
    assert result.returncode == 0, 'READONLY_OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE'
    return result.stdout if binary else result.stdout.decode('utf-8')
state = {'version': 1, 'platform': platform, 'readOnly': True, 'commands': commands}
if platform == 'ios':
    base = ['xcrun', 'simctl', '--set', prep['ios']['set']]
    device = prep['ios']['udid']
    listing = json.loads(run(base + ['list', 'devices', '-j']))['devices']
    selected = [item for items in listing.values() for item in items if item['udid'] == device]
    assert len(selected) == 1 and selected[0]['state'] == 'Booted'
    state['device'] = selected[0]
    services = []
    for line in run(base + ['spawn', device, 'launchctl', 'list']).splitlines():
        fields = line.split(None, 2)
        if len(fields) == 3 and fields[0].isdigit():
            pid = int(fields[0])
            services.append({'pid': pid, 'label': fields[2], 'incarnation': group.process_incarnation(pid),
                             'automation': 'com.facebook.WebDriverAgentRunner' in fields[2]})
    state['services'] = services
    container = Path(run(base + ['get_app_container', device, 'com.facebook.WebDriverAgentRunner.xctrunner', 'app']).strip())
    assert str(container).startswith(str(Path(prep['ios']['set']) / device / 'data') + '/')
    manifest = prep['wda']
    state['wda'] = {'container': str(container), 'packageVersion': manifest['packageVersion'],
                    'files': [{'path': item['path'], 'sha256': hashlib.sha256((container / item['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                               'matchesSelected': hashlib.sha256((container / item['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == item['sha256']} for item in manifest['files']]}
    assert all(item['matchesSelected'] for item in state['wda']['files'])
else:
    serial = prep['android']['serial']
    base = ['adb', '-s', serial]
    assert run(base + ['emu', 'avd', 'name']).splitlines()[0] == prep['android']['name']
    state['device'] = {'avd': prep['android']['name'], 'serial': serial, 'bootId': run(base + ['shell', 'cat', '/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id']).strip(),
                       'abi': run(base + ['shell', 'getprop', 'ro.product.cpu.abi']).strip()}
    packages = ['io.appium.uiautomator2.server', 'io.appium.uiautomator2.server.test', 'io.appium.settings']
    rows = []
    for line in run(base + ['shell', 'ps', '-A', '-o', 'PID,NAME']).splitlines():
        fields = line.split()
        if len(fields) == 2 and fields[0].isdigit() and any(fields[1] == package or fields[1].startswith(package + ':') for package in packages):
            pid = int(fields[0]); raw = run(base + ['shell', 'cat', '/proc/' + str(pid) + '/stat'])
            rows.append({'pid': pid, 'name': fields[1], 'startTicks': raw.rsplit(') ', 1)[1].split()[19]})
    state['processes'] = rows
    state['packages'] = []
    for package in packages:
        paths = run(base + ['shell', 'pm', 'path', package]).splitlines()
        assert len(paths) == 1 and paths[0].startswith('package:/data/app/')
        path = paths[0][8:]
        apk = run(base + ['exec-out', 'cat', path], binary=True)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(apk).hexdigest()
        approved = prep['androidAutomationApks']
        matches = [item for item in approved if item['package'] == package and item['sha256'] == digest]
        assert len(matches) == 1, 'INSTALLED_AUTOMATION_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH'
        state['packages'].append({'package': package, 'installedPath': path, 'sha256': digest, 'bytes': len(apk), 'selectedArtifact': matches[0]})
    input_state = run(base + ['shell', 'dumpsys', 'input'])
    state['inputStateSha256'] = hashlib.sha256(input_state.encode()).hexdigest()
    state['inputTouchSections'] = [line for line in input_state.splitlines() if any(word in line for word in ['TouchStates', 'Pointers:', 'downTime', 'PointerIds'])]
print(json.dumps(state))

"""Create an isolated process group and persist its identity before exec."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import importlib.util
import uuid
import base64

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("owned_group", Path(__file__).with_name("stop-group.py"))
group = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(group)

os.umask(0o077)
record_path = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
os.setsid()
birth = " ".join(subprocess.check_output(["ps", "-p", str(os.getpid()), "-o", "lstart="], text=True).split())
record = {"version": 1, "pid": os.getpid(), "pgid": os.getpgrp(), "sid": os.getsid(0), "birth": birth,
          "incarnation": group.process_incarnation(os.getpid()),
          "executable": str(Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()), "script": str(Path(sys.argv[3]).resolve()), "members": []}
record["runMarker"] = uuid.uuid4().hex
record["launchChain"] = [{"pid": record["pid"], "incarnation": record["incarnation"]}]
os.environ["JEV_PHASE1_RUN_MARKER"] = record["runMarker"]
os.environ["JEV_PHASE1_ANCESTRY"] = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(record["launchChain"], separators=(",", ":")).encode()).decode()
assert record["pid"] == record["pgid"]
assert record["incarnation"]
with record_path.open("x") as file:
    json.dump(record, file)
    file.flush()
    os.fsync(file.fileno())
directory = os.open(record_path.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
try:
    os.fsync(directory)
finally:
    os.close(directory)
os.environ["JEV_STOP_GROUP_RECORD"] = str(record_path)
os.execv(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[2:])

"""Pinned-stack ownership through inherited launch markers and recorded ancestry."""
import base64
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('owned_group', Path(__file__).with_name('stop-group.py'))
group = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(group)
MARKER = 'JEV_PHASE1_RUN_MARKER'
CHAIN = 'JEV_PHASE1_ANCESTRY'


def encode_chain(chain):
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(chain, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).decode()


def scan(root, owner, profile):
    marker = owner.get('runMarker')
    assert isinstance(marker, str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{32}', marker), 'MISSING_LAUNCH_ATTESTATION'
    ancestor = {'pid': owner['pid'], 'incarnation': owner['incarnation']}
    assert owner.get('launchChain') == [ancestor], 'MISSING_LAUNCH_ANCESTRY'
    timeout = profile.get('inspectionTimeoutSeconds', 10) if profile.get('fakeOnly') else 10
    assert 0 < timeout <= 20
    result = subprocess.run(['ps', '-Eww', '-axo', 'pid=,ppid=,pgid=,stat=,command='],
                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
    assert result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.strip(), 'HOST_INVENTORY_FAILED'
    if profile.get('fakeOnly'):
        markers = [profile['marker']]
    else:
        caps = profile['caps']
        if profile['platform'] == 'ios':
            assert caps['appium:udid'] == '15013501-2535-42EB-A67F-45B015DF18F4', 'FOREIGN_DEVICE'
            markers = [caps['appium:udid'], caps['appium:simulatorDevicesSetPath'], '18100', '18101']
        else:
            assert caps['appium:udid'] == 'emulator-5570', 'FOREIGN_DEVICE'
            markers = ['emulator-5570', '18200', '18201']
    records = [owner]
    for file in sorted((root / 'components').glob('*.json')):
        record = json.loads(file.read_text())
        assert record['ownerPid'] == owner['pid'] and record['ownerIncarnation'] == owner['incarnation'], 'FOREIGN_COMPONENT_RECORD'
        records.append(record)
    recorded = {record['pid']: record['incarnation'] for record in records}
    pgids = {record['pgid'] for record in records}
    sids = {record['sid'] for record in records if record.get('sid', 0) > 1}
    raw_rows = []
    for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
        parts = line.strip().split(None, 4)
        assert len(parts) == 5, 'HOST_INVENTORY_TRUNCATED'
        pid, ppid, pgid, state, command = parts
        tagged = re.search(r'(?:^| )' + MARKER + '=' + re.escape(marker) + r'(?: |$)', command) is not None
        matched = any(re.search(r'(?<![\w-])' + re.escape(value) + r'(?![\w-])', command, re.IGNORECASE) for value in markers)
        try:
            sid = os.getsid(int(pid))
        except (ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
            sid = None
        readable = tagged or re.search(r'(?:^| )(?:PATH|HOME|USER|SHELL|TMPDIR|' + MARKER + r')=', command) is not None
        raw_rows.append({'pid': int(pid), 'ppid': int(ppid), 'pgid': int(pgid), 'sid': sid,
                         'state': state, 'command': command, 'tagged': tagged, 'matched': matched,
                         'markerState': 'present' if tagged else 'absent' if readable else 'unreadable'})
    linked = set(recorded)
    while True:
        additions = {row['pid'] for row in raw_rows if row['ppid'] in linked}
        if additions <= linked:
            break
        linked |= additions
    rows = []
    for row in raw_rows:
        pid, ppid, pgid, sid, state, command, tagged = (row[key] for key in ['pid', 'ppid', 'pgid', 'sid', 'state', 'command', 'tagged'])
        related = pid in linked or pgid in pgids or sid in sids
        if pid == os.getpid() or not (tagged or row['matched'] or related):
            continue
        chain = None
        value = re.search(r'(?:^| )' + CHAIN + r'=([^ ]+)', command)
        if value:
            try:
                chain = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(value[1]))
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                pass
        identity = group.process_incarnation(int(pid))
        owned = tagged and isinstance(chain, list) and bool(chain) and chain[0] == ancestor and bool(identity)
        shared = group.is_shared_service(command)
        rows.append({'pid': int(pid), 'ppid': int(ppid), 'pgid': int(pgid), 'state': state,
                     'sid': sid, 'markerState': row['markerState'], 'incarnation': identity, 'active': not state.startswith('Z'), 'runMarker': marker if tagged else None,
                     'launchChain': chain, 'owned': owned and not shared, 'excludedSharedService': shared,
                     'ownerPid': owner['pid'], 'ownerIncarnation': owner['incarnation'],
                     'reason': None if owned else 'MARKER_UNREADABLE' if row['markerState'] == 'unreadable' else 'UNVERIFIABLE_OWNERSHIP'})
    return rows

"""Stop only a group created by owned-launcher.py, with incarnation checks."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import ctypes
import struct
import re

def is_shared_service(command):
    executable = command.split(None, 1)[0].rsplit('/', 1)[-1] if command.strip() else ''
    return executable in ['CoreSimulatorService', 'com.apple.CoreSimulator.CoreSimulatorService'] or (
        executable == 'adb' and re.search(r'\bfork-server\b.*\bserver\b', command) is not None)

def process_command(pid):
    result = subprocess.run(['ps', '-p', str(pid), '-o', 'command='], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=2)
    return result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else None

def process_incarnation(pid):
    if sys.platform == "darwin":
        # Xcode's public sys/proc_info.h: PROC_PIDTBSDINFO=3, 136-byte
        # proc_bsdinfo, with start timeval at offset 120. Refuse short reads.
        library = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/lib/libproc.dylib")
        buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(136)
        count = library.proc_pidinfo(pid, 3, 0, buffer, 136)
        if count != 136:
            return None
        seconds, micros = struct.unpack_from("=QQ", buffer.raw, 120)
        return f"darwin:{seconds}:{micros}"
    if sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
        try:
            fields = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/stat").read_text().rsplit(")", 1)[1].split()
            boot = Path("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id").read_text().strip()
            return f"linux:{boot}:{fields[19]}"
        except OSError:
            return None
    raise AssertionError("Process incarnation unavailable on this host")

def processes(pgid=None):
    args = ["ps", "-g", str(pgid)] if pgid is not None else ["ps", "-ax"]
    result = subprocess.run(args + ["-o", "pid=,ppid=,pgid=,stat=,lstart=,command="], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
    if result.returncode == 1 and not result.stdout.strip():
        return []
    result.check_returncode()
    output = result.stdout
    rows = []
    for line in output.splitlines():
        fields = line.split(None, 9)
        if len(fields) == 10:
            rows.append({"pid": int(fields[0]), "ppid": int(fields[1]), "pgid": int(fields[2]),
                         "state": fields[3], "birth": " ".join(fields[4:9]), "command": fields[9]})
    return rows

def stop_group(owner):
    pgid = owner["pgid"]
    assert owner["version"] == 1 and pgid == owner["pid"] and pgid > 1
    assert pgid != os.getpgrp(), "Refuse the controller's group"
    before = [row for row in processes(pgid) if row["pgid"] == pgid]
    for row in before:
        row["incarnation"] = process_incarnation(row["pid"])
    active = [row for row in before if not row["state"].startswith("Z")]
    assert owner.get("incarnation"), "Missing owner incarnation"
    expected = [{"pid": owner["pid"], "incarnation": owner["incarnation"]}] + owner["members"]
    leader = next((row for row in active if row["pid"] == owner["pid"]), None)
    if leader:
        assert leader["incarnation"] == owner["incarnation"] and owner["script"] in leader["command"], "Owner incarnation mismatch"
    receipt = {"groupStopped": False, "owner": owner, "before": before, "signals": []}
    for name, duration in [("SIGTERM", 3), ("SIGKILL", 3)]:
        if not active:
            break
        assert not any(is_shared_service(row['command']) for row in active), 'EXCLUDED_SHARED_SERVICE'
        assert all(any(row['pid'] == identity['pid'] and row['incarnation'] and row['incarnation'] == identity.get('incarnation')
                       for identity in expected) for row in active), 'UNATTESTED_GROUP_MEMBER'
        os.killpg(pgid, getattr(signal, name))
        receipt["signals"].append(name)
        end = time.monotonic() + duration
        while time.monotonic() < end:
            active = [row for row in processes(pgid) if row["pgid"] == pgid and not row["state"].startswith("Z")]
            for row in active:
                row["incarnation"] = process_incarnation(row["pid"])
            if not active:
                break
            time.sleep(0.1)
    receipt["after"] = [row for row in processes(pgid) if row["pgid"] == pgid]
    assert not any(not row["state"].startswith("Z") for row in receipt["after"]), "Owned group still active"
    receipt["groupStopped"] = True
    return receipt

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if sys.argv[1] == "identities":
        print(json.dumps([{"pid": int(pid), "incarnation": process_incarnation(int(pid))} for pid in sys.argv[2:]]))
    else:
        owner_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
        owner = json.loads(owner_path.read_text())
        records = [json.loads(file.read_text()) for file in sorted((owner_path.parent / 'components').glob('*.json'))]
        snapshot = owner_path.parent / 'descendants-before-stop.json'
        if snapshot.exists():
            records += [row for row in json.loads(snapshot.read_text()).get('candidates', []) if row.get('owned')]
        for row in records:
            assert row['ownerPid'] == owner['pid'] and row['ownerIncarnation'] == owner['incarnation'], 'FOREIGN_COMPONENT_RECORD'
        owner['members'] += [{'pid': row['pid'], 'incarnation': row['incarnation']} for row in records]
        print(json.dumps(stop_group(owner)))

"""Inspect/stop exact recorded child incarnations, including escaped groups."""
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import sys
import time

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('owned_group', Path(__file__).with_name('stop-group.py'))
group = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(group)
directory, owner_path, mode = sys.argv[1:]
assert mode in ['inspect', 'stop']
root = Path(directory).resolve()
assert root.stat().st_uid == os.getuid() and root.stat().st_mode & 0o077 == 0
owner = json.loads(Path(owner_path).read_text())
records = []
for file in sorted((root / 'components').glob('*.json')):
    assert not file.is_symlink() and file.stat().st_uid == os.getuid() and file.stat().st_mode & 0o077 == 0
    record = json.loads(file.read_text())
    assert record['ownerPid'] == owner['pid'] and record['ownerIncarnation'] == owner['incarnation']
    records.append(record)
snapshot = root / 'descendants-before-stop.json'
if snapshot.exists():
    saved = json.loads(snapshot.read_text())
    records += [row for row in saved.get('candidates', []) if row.get('owned') and row['pid'] != owner['pid']]
rows = []
seen = set()
for record in records:
    assert record['ownerPid'] == owner['pid'] and record['ownerIncarnation'] == owner['incarnation']
    pid = record['pid']
    key = (pid, record['incarnation'])
    if key in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(key)
    assert isinstance(pid, int) and pid > 1 and pid not in [os.getpid(), owner['pid']]
    before = group.process_incarnation(pid)
    signals = []
    if before == record['incarnation']:
        command = group.process_command(pid)
        assert command, 'LIVE_COMPONENT_COMMAND_UNREADABLE'
        if group.is_shared_service(command):
            rows.append({**record, 'signals': [], 'stopped': False, 'excludedSharedService': True})
            continue
    if mode == 'stop' and before == record['incarnation']:
        for sig, timeout in [(signal.SIGTERM, 2), (signal.SIGKILL, 2)]:
            if group.process_incarnation(pid) != record['incarnation']:
                break
            try:
                os.kill(pid, sig)
                signals.append(sig.name)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                break
            deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
            while time.monotonic() < deadline and group.process_incarnation(pid) == record['incarnation']:
                time.sleep(0.05)
    after = group.process_incarnation(pid)
    # A different incarnation is never signalled; the recorded one is absent.
    stopped = after is not None and after != record['incarnation']
    if not stopped:
        try:
            import subprocess
            stopped = subprocess.check_output(['ps', '-p', str(pid), '-o', 'stat='], text=True, timeout=2).strip().startswith('Z')
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError as error:
            stopped = error.returncode == 1
    rows.append({**record, 'beforeIncarnation': before, 'afterIncarnation': after, 'signals': signals, 'stopped': stopped})
complete = all(row['stopped'] or row.get('excludedSharedService') for row in rows)
print(json.dumps({'version': 1, 'mode': mode, 'components': rows, 'recordedChildrenStopped': complete}))
if mode == 'stop' and not complete:
    sys.exit(1)

"""Bounded shutdown/verification for the two fixed, privately created devices."""
import json
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import re
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("stop_group", Path(__file__).with_name("stop-group.py"))
group_module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(group_module)
processes = group_module.processes

preparation_path, platform, mode = sys.argv[1:]
preparation = json.loads(Path(preparation_path).read_text())
assert platform in ["ios", "android"] and mode in ["stop", "verify"]
assert preparation["ios"]["udid"] == "40A5E14C-7B08-43A0-844A-76FB94B4B34A", "Refuse foreign device"
assert preparation["android"]["name"] == "jev_appium_phase1_20261013", "Refuse foreign AVD"
assert preparation["android"]["serial"] == "emulator-5570", "Refuse foreign serial"
root = Path(preparation_path).resolve().parent.parent
assert Path(preparation["ios"]["set"]).resolve() == root / "runtime/devices/simulators", "Refuse foreign simulator set"
deadline = time.monotonic() + 90
receipt = {"version": 1, "kind": "private-device-shutdown", "platform": platform,
           "commands": [], "deviceOffline": False, "ownedPortsClosed": False, "leaseReleased": False}

def run(args, timeout=15):
    remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
    assert remaining > 0, "Native stop deadline exceeded"
    result = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=min(timeout, remaining))
    record = {"args": args, "exitCode": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr}
    receipt["commands"].append(record)
    return record

def ios_state():
    result = run(["xcrun", "simctl", "--set", preparation["ios"]["set"], "list", "devices", "-j"])
    assert result["exitCode"] == 0
    devices = json.loads(result["stdout"])["devices"]
    owned = [item for entries in devices.values() for item in entries if item["udid"] == preparation["ios"]["udid"]]
    assert len(owned) == 1 and owned[0]["name"] == preparation["ios"]["name"]
    return owned[0]["state"]

def emulator_rows():
    pattern = r"-avd\s+" + re.escape(preparation["android"]["name"]) + r"(?:\s|$)"
    rows = [row for row in processes() if re.search(pattern, row["command"]) and not row["state"].startswith("Z")]
    for row in rows:
        row["incarnation"] = group_module.process_incarnation(row["pid"])
    return rows

if platform == "ios":
    receipt["device"] = preparation["ios"]["udid"]
    if mode == "stop" and ios_state() != "Shutdown":
        result = run(["xcrun", "simctl", "--set", preparation["ios"]["set"], "shutdown", receipt["device"]], 40)
        assert result["exitCode"] == 0
    ports = [18100, 18101]
else:
    receipt["device"] = preparation["android"]["name"]
    serial = preparation["android"]["serial"]
    listing = run(["adb", "devices"]); assert listing["exitCode"] == 0
    already_offline = not any(line.split() and line.split()[0] == serial for line in listing["stdout"].splitlines()) and not emulator_rows()
    receipt["alreadyOffline"] = already_offline
    if mode == "stop" and not already_offline:
        name = run(["adb", "-s", serial, "emu", "avd", "name"])
        assert name["exitCode"] == 0 and name["stdout"].splitlines()[0] == receipt["device"]
        receipt["emulatorBefore"] = emulator_rows()
        assert len(receipt["emulatorBefore"]) == 1, "Emulator process identity unverified"
        for package in ["io.appium.uiautomator2.server", "io.appium.uiautomator2.server.test", "io.appium.settings"]:
            result = run(["adb", "-s", serial, "shell", "am", "force-stop", package]); assert result["exitCode"] == 0
            result = run(["adb", "-s", serial, "shell", "pm", "disable-user", "--user", "0", package])
            assert result["exitCode"] == 0 and "disabled-user" in result["stdout"]
        forwards = run(["adb", "forward", "--list"]); assert forwards["exitCode"] == 0
        for local, remote in [("tcp:18200", "tcp:6790"), ("tcp:18201", "tcp:7810")]:
            matches = [line.split() for line in forwards["stdout"].splitlines() if len(line.split()) == 3 and line.split()[1] == local]
            assert all(row == [serial, local, remote] for row in matches), "Foreign forward; refuse removal"
            if matches:
                result = run(["adb", "-s", serial, "forward", "--remove", local]); assert result["exitCode"] == 0
        name = run(["adb", "-s", serial, "emu", "avd", "name"])
        assert name["exitCode"] == 0 and name["stdout"].splitlines()[0] == receipt["device"]
        current = emulator_rows()
        assert len(current) == 1 and current[0]["incarnation"] and all(current[0][key] == receipt["emulatorBefore"][0][key] for key in ["pid", "incarnation"]), "Emulator incarnation changed"
        result = run(["adb", "-s", serial, "emu", "kill"]); assert result["exitCode"] == 0
    ports = [18200, 18201, 5570, 5571]

def observe():
    if platform == "ios":
        state = ios_state()
        offline = state == "Shutdown"
        native = [row for row in processes() if preparation["ios"]["udid"] in row["command"] and not row["state"].startswith("Z")]
        offline = offline and not native
    else:
        result = run(["adb", "devices"]); assert result["exitCode"] == 0
        offline = not any(line.split() and line.split()[0] == serial for line in result["stdout"].splitlines())
        native = emulator_rows()
        state = "absent" if not native else "running"
        offline = offline and not native
    closed = []
    for port in ports:
        with socket.socket() as sock:
            sock.settimeout(0.5)
            closed.append(sock.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", port)) != 0)
    return {"state": state, "deviceOffline": offline, "ownedPortsClosed": all(closed)}

receipt["observations"] = []
first = observe()
while mode == "stop" and not (first["deviceOffline"] and first["ownedPortsClosed"]):
    assert time.monotonic() < deadline, "Native stop deadline exceeded"
    time.sleep(0.25)
    first = observe()
for attempt in range(6):
    observation = first if attempt == 0 else observe()
    observation["elapsedSample"] = attempt
    receipt["observations"].append(observation)
    assert observation["deviceOffline"] and observation["ownedPortsClosed"], "Owned device or automation endpoint still active"
    if attempt < 5:
        time.sleep(1)
receipt["deviceOffline"] = True
receipt["ownedPortsClosed"] = True
print(json.dumps(receipt))

"""Bounded host parsing only. No device or file entity access."""
import json
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

try:
    request = json.load(sys.stdin)
    xml = request['xml']
    platform = request['platform']
    assert len(xml.encode('utf-8')) <= 1024 * 1024
    assert '<!DOCTYPE' not in xml.upper() and '<!ENTITY' not in xml.upper()
    root = ET.fromstring(xml)
    assert root.tag == ('AppiumAUT' if platform == 'ios' else 'hierarchy')
    nodes = list(root.iter())
    assert len(nodes) <= 10000
    pending = [(root, 1)]
    while pending:
        node, depth = pending.pop()
        assert depth <= 128
        pending.extend((child, depth + 1) for child in node)
    key, value = ('name', 'value') if platform == 'ios' else ('resource-id', 'text')
    summaries = [node for node in nodes if node.get(key) == 'selection.summary']
    assert len(summaries) == 1 and value in summaries[0].attrib
    print(json.dumps({'summary': summaries[0].get(value), 'nodeCount': len(nodes)}))
except Exception:
    print('INVALID_XML_RESULT', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

"""One bounded pinned-stack inventory; unknown ownership retains quarantine."""
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ownership', Path(__file__).with_name('process-ownership.py'))
ownership = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(ownership)
directory, owner_path, mode = sys.argv[1:]
assert mode in ['snapshot', 'verify']
root = Path(directory).resolve()
receipt = {'version': 2, 'mode': mode, 'scanCount': 1, 'readOnly': True,
           'inspectionComplete': False, 'sharedServicesStopped': False, 'verified': False, 'quarantined': True}
try:
    owner = json.loads(Path(owner_path).read_text())
    profile = json.loads((root / 'profile.json').read_text())
    candidates = ownership.scan(root, owner, profile)
    receipt['candidates'] = candidates
    receipt['inspectionComplete'] = True
    unknown = [row for row in candidates if row['active'] and not row['owned'] and not row['excludedSharedService']]
    if mode == 'verify':
        previous = json.loads((root / 'descendants-before-stop.json').read_text())
        assert previous.get('inspectionComplete'), 'PRE_STOP_INVENTORY_UNVERIFIED'
        for row in previous['candidates']:
            if row.get('excludedSharedService') or not row['active']:
                continue
            identity = ownership.group.process_incarnation(row['pid'])
            if row['incarnation'] is None or identity is None or identity == row['incarnation']:
                check = subprocess.run(['ps', '-p', str(row['pid']), '-o', 'stat='], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=2)
                if not ((check.returncode == 1 and not check.stdout.strip()) or
                        (check.returncode == 0 and check.stdout.strip().startswith('Z'))):
                    unknown.append({**row, 'reason': 'RECORDED_PROCESS_STILL_ACTIVE'})
        receipt['priorCandidatesAbsent'] = not unknown
        unknown += [row for row in candidates if row['active'] and row['owned']]
    receipt['unverifiedComponents'] = unknown
    receipt['verified'] = not unknown
    receipt['quarantined'] = bool(unknown)
except Exception as error:
    receipt['reason'] = 'HOST_INVENTORY_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED' if isinstance(error, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) else type(error).__name__ + ': ' + str(error)
print(json.dumps(receipt))
if not receipt['verified']:
    sys.exit(1)
